questionEn: Choose the only correct option about “The importance of minerals in human life”?
questionUz: "Minerallarning inson hayotidagi ahamiyati" haqidagi yagona to'g'ri variantni tanlang?
choicesEn: Elements necessary for the life of organisms
Organic substances consisting of carbon, hydrogen and oxygen (sugar, etc.)
Organic substances needed by the body in small quantities
choicesUz: Organizmlar hayoti uchun zarur bo'lgan elementlar
Uglerod, vodorod va kisloroddan (shakar va boshqalar) tashkil topgan organik moddalar.
Organik moddalar organizmga oz miqdorda kerak
